task_description: Add a complete WhatsApp Agent section to the existing Carmel College voice agent dashboard. New features: SetSmart API proxy in server.js, types/setsmart.ts, setsmartClient.ts + setsmart.ts API layer, useSetSmart.ts hooks, three new pages (WhatsAppAgentPage, WhatsAppConversationsPage, WhatsAppLeadsPage), sidebar nav update, OverviewPage WhatsApp section + KPIs, and App.tsx routing — all without touching any existing Sarvam functionality.
